messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate - 5m error-rate=4.8% (threshold=1%). p95 latency 1.2s. link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/alerts

sam: picking this up, oncall here. looking at logs and metrics now.

sam: logs show a bunch of upstream 502/gateway errors from provider embedder-us-west. sample:```
2026-03-17T14:03:12Z ERROR upstream_response=502 provider=embedder-us-west req_id=9f3a2c
2026-03-17T14:03:13Z ERROR upstream_response=502 provider=embedder-us-west req_id=9f3a2d
```

julia: confirmed, I can see the provider's success-rate diving in us-west region. likely an upstream outage causing 502s, not our model runtime.

arjun: suggestion: route a portion of traffic away from embedder-us-west to fallback pool (fallback-small) and enable circuit breaker on that provider. I can flip routing from infra side. curl to toggle: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route -d '{"provider":"embedder-us-west","weight":0.7}'`

sam: please do. starting mitigation: lowering weight to 0.6 now. will observe.

arjun: done — set embedder-us-west weight -> 0.6, fallback-small -> 0.4. watch metrics.

deploy-bot: routing change commit 7a3e4f applied by arjun.

maria: CS update: several enterprise customers report 502s in the last 10 minutes, we got 6 priority tickets. customers mostly on us-west.

sam: added temporary rate-limit/circuit-breaker on requests to embedder-us-west: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/circuit -d '{"provider":"embedder-us-west","max_rps":5}'` — this will shed excess load to fallback.

julia: good. for alerts: current 5xx alert is too sensitive during transient upstream failures (fires at 1% over 5m). propose changing to: 5xx > 3% over 10m AND requests > 1000 in window. reduces noise for small blips but still pages on real impact.

arjun: agree. also add a secondary alert for provider-specific 5xx spikes so we can distinguish internal regressions vs upstream provider failures. I'll open a Grafana panel: /d/redwood/provider-errors?panel=embedder-us-west

sam: making the alert change now (temporarily) — will update paging rule to require both conditions.

sam: changed alert rule inops-5xx to: `if (5xx_rate > 0.03 AND sum(requests) > 1000) for 10m then page`. note: will push a PR to infra-alerts repo for permanent change.

maria: can we add a dashboard that shows customer-facing 5xx counts by customer ID? that'll help triage tickets faster.

arjun: on it — I'll add a panel grouping by tenant_id and region, and hook it to the CS shared dashboard.

sam: current status: routing partially shifted, circuit breaker enabled, 5xx rate dropped from 4.8% -> 1.5% in last 6m. customers still seeing intermittent 502s but trending down.

julia: follow-ups: (1) contact embedder provider support and share logs, (2) persist alert rule change via PR, (3) create dashboard panel for tenant-level 5xx, (4) postmortem if provider confirms degradation >30m.

sam: handoff time — I need to sign off in 10m. summary for next oncall: we mitigated by traffic shift + circuit breaker; alerts relaxed to reduce noise; monitor provider health and customer tickets. next: finish provider contact and PRs.

julia: ack, taking over. will keep monitoring and escalate to platform lead if we see another spike. opening internal ticket: INF-3897 (provider outage investigation).

arjun: I've created the panel and started the PR for alert rule. link: https://git.redwood/infra-alerts/pull/512

maria: posting a short CS update: "We're seeing reduced errors; mitigation in place. Engineers are monitoring; we'll update when provider confirms resolution." :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [RESOLVED?] 5xx rate back to baseline 0.9% — monitor for 15m to clear.

sam: thanks team, leaving notes in the handoff doc. julia, please take the postmortem if this persists.

julia: will do. logging notes + tagging relevant owners. :white_check_mark:
